items.question: How do I apply for jobs on Ujobs India?
items.answer: Applying is easy! 1. Download the app, 2. Complete your profile (no resume needed!), 3. Search for jobs in your city, 4. Click "Quick Apply". Employers will contact you directly via call or WhatsApp.

items.question: Is Ujobs India free for job seekers?
items.answer: Yes, Free for Job Seekers. We never charge job seekers for applications, profile creation, or interviews. If someone asks for money representing Ujobs, please report it immediately.

items.question: How are job postings Trusted?
items.answer: Every employer on our platform undergoes a strict KYC Profile Vetting process. We Check their GST/PAN details and office location to ensure all job postings are genuine and safe.

items.question: Can I search for jobs in my local area?
items.answer: Yes! Our smart location filter allows you to find jobs within 5-10km of your home. This helps you save on travel time and costs.

items.question: What documents do I need to apply?
items.answer: Most blue-collar jobs only require an Aadhaar Card and basic contact details. Some specialized roles might ask for a driving license or bank account details for salary transfers.

items.question: Which mobile platforms are supported?

items.question: Are the job seekers and employers Trusted on the app?
items.answer: Absolutely. Ujobs India implements robust Profile Vetting and ID Profile Vetting systems. All candidates are Trusted so you can hire trusted domestic help, nurses, drivers, and other specialists with full peace of mind.

seo.title: Terms of Use | Ujobs India
seo.description: Read the terms of use, guidelines, and conditions for using the Ujobs India direct matching platform.
seo.keywords: terms of use, terms and conditions, ujobs legal, user agreement, direct hiring rules

sections.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
sections.content: By downloading, installing, registering, or accessing the Ujobs India mobile application or website, you agree to be legally bound by these Terms of Use, our Privacy Policy, and all applicable laws and regulations in India. You must be at least 18 years of age to register or use our services. If you do not agree to these terms, you must immediately cease using the platform.

sections.title: 2. Platform Role & Non-Agency Disclaimer
sections.content: Ujobs India is an independent technology platform managed by Ayushya Healthcare Services. We operate solely as a matching utility to facilitate direct communication between household/corporate employers and independent job seekers. Ujobs India is not a recruitment agency, employment broker, or labor contractor. We do not employ, select, supervise, or recommend any workers listed on our platform.
list: No Surety or Guarantees: We provide self-submitted profile indicators. We do not guarantee the performance, character, background safety, or legal eligibility of any job seeker.
Independent Due Diligence: Employers are strictly advised and responsible for performing their own independent reference checks, Aadhaar/ID checks, and interviewing candidates before hiring.
No Employment Contract: Any hiring arrangement or payment terms agreed upon are strictly private agreements between the employer and the worker.

sections.title: 3. User Responsibilities & Conduct
sections.content: To maintain a safe and trustworthy community, all users agree to adhere to the following responsibilities when accessing our services:
list: Provide 100% accurate, current, and complete registration details, and refrain from creating fraudulent or duplicate profiles.
Refrain from posting any abusive, offensive, defamatory, commercial spam, or illegal content.
Comply with all applicable local, state, and central laws, including fair employment, non-discrimination, and minimum wage guidelines.
Never solicit or charge money from job seekers for interview coordinates or job placements.

sections.title: 4. Fair Work & Wage Standards
sections.content: Employers using Ujobs India agree to provide fair pay, safe and sanitary working conditions, and reasonable working hours to any hired worker. Discrimination based on gender, caste, religion, region, or physical ability is strictly prohibited. Misbehavior or failure to pay agreed-upon wages will lead to permanent account suspension and reporting to relevant local law enforcement authorities.

sections.title: 5. Limitation of Liability
sections.content: In no event shall Ujobs India, its directors, employees, parent company (Ayushya Healthcare Services), or affiliates be liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages, disputes, financial losses, or physical harm arising out of or in connection with the direct matching, direct calls, interviews, or hiring transactions conducted through our platform. All matches are done voluntarily and at the user's sole discretion.

seo.title: Privacy Policy | Ujobs India
seo.description: Learn how Ujobs India collects, encrypts, and protects your personal information in compliance with the DPDP Act.
seo.keywords: privacy policy, data protection, dpdp act compliance, data encryption, user data security, ujobs privacy

sections.title: 1. Information Collection
sections.content: To facilitate secure direct matches, we collect the personal information you voluntarily provide to us when registering on the Ujobs India mobile application:
list: Registration Details: Name, verified mobile phone number, preferred language, role (Employer or Job Seeker), and profile photo.
Professional Profile (Job Seekers): Work category, years of experience, age, gender, expected salary, and approximate neighborhood location.
Self-Declared Documents: Aadhaar number, PAN details, or police clearance certificates uploaded voluntarily by the worker to confirm profile registration status.

sections.title: 2. Compliance with Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act
sections.content: Ujobs India is fully compliant with the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act of India. We employ enterprise-grade security protocols, including AES-256 data encryption at rest and secure TLS 1.3 encryption in transit, to ensure your private documents and data remain 100% safe from unauthorized access.

sections.title: 3. How We Use and Share Information
sections.content: Your data is only used to enable direct staffing connections. We display basic profile details (Name, Experience, Neighborhood) and verification indicators (like 'ID-Checked') to verified employers on our platform. We do not sell, rent, or lease your private contact numbers or documents to third-party advertisers or external marketing networks under any circumstances.

sections.title: 4. Location Services & Permissions
sections.content: Our app utilizes approximate location data (with your active, explicit consent) to display suitable jobs and candidate profiles within a 5-10km radius of your home. This data is processed locally on our servers and is never permanently stored or shared with external parties.

sections.title: 5. User Rights, Data Deletion, and Correction
sections.content: Under privacy regulations, you retain full rights over your personal data. You can access, edit, update, or permanently delete your account and uploaded documents at any time. Simply use the in-app account settings, or contact our support helpline directly at support@ujobsindia.com to request immediate data purge.
